The tutorial's LuV briefing, honored in full: machine parts now want rhodium-plated palladium, the Assembly Line becomes mandatory for high-tier components, and the suggested destinations are Io, Venus and Mercury.

The crystal circuit family lives here — chips, processors, mainframes — with the tutorial noting the Crystal Mainframe is the first UV circuit you can make. Overachievement is a LuV tradition.

This final spine segment is five quests long, and then the rest of the book takes over: deep integration, challenges, and the exchange counter.
